title: 3.2 I, You and We
unit_title: Unit 3: Me, You and Other People
unit_outcome: Greet people, say who you are, your age, where you are from and your job, and say what belongs to whom.
goal: Say ich bin, du bist and wir sind with names, and hear the verb endings for ich, du and wir.
grammar_function: ich bin, du bist, wir sind; ich + verb-e, du + verb-st, wir + verb-en.
speaking_outcome: Say who you are and what you and others are doing.

cards.pedagogy_note: wir + verb-en, like sie (they): Wir reden.
